encyclopedia.name: THC Plant Science Encyclopedia
encyclopedia.purpose: Encyclopedia-style topics and explanations covering cannabis plant science, cultivation, diagnostics, genetics, postharvest, quality, and related knowledge.

certification.name: THC Academy Certification Curriculum
certification.purpose: Dedicated certification courses and tests built specifically for certificate and professional credential pathways.
certification.courseMaterialRule: Every certification course must contain its own dedicated objectives, lessons, explanations, examples, visuals, activities, practice, scenarios, remediation, and applicable practical work. Required knowledge must be taught inside the course.
certification.testMaterialRule: Every Certification Course Test must be built from that course's current controlled objectives and material actually taught or practiced in that course. No scored item may depend only on encyclopedia content, external reference-only material, a blueprint, or another course.

legacy420Catalog.name: Historical THC-C001..THC-C420 catalog
legacy420Catalog.purpose: Historical topic map retained for provenance and reconciliation.

countingRules.encyclopediaCompletion: Count only THC-ENC-001..THC-ENC-420 encyclopedia records and their own production state.
countingRules.certificationCompletion: Count only dedicated certification-course objects (`COURSE-LH-*`), their own course lessons/objectives, course-specific tests/items, practicals, and their release state.
countingRules.certificationTestCoverage: A course test counts coverage only when each scored item maps to a current objective owned by that same course and taught in that course.
